answer: One identity costs one refundable bond of 120 POA locked for 40 days, and a single bond cannot cover two accounts. The agent forges its device key into a public ledge of bonded identities, so a duplicate key shows up for anyone to see. Three auditors drawn at random each week check the ledge, and an identity caught sharing a key loses its full bond and is barred. New identities spend seven days in an open meadow where trades stay public, so copies get flagged before any bond unlocks.
